scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html styles.css app.js dist/
scripts.test: node --check app.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const readme=fs.readFileSync('README.md','utf8'); for (const s of ['PUBLIC REPOSITORY EXPLORER','Orientation','Trace','Inspect']) if (!html.includes(s)) throw new Error('missing '+s); for (const s of ['Overview','Product Flow','Architecture','Evolution','Evaluation']) if (!readme.includes(s)) throw new Error('missing '+s); console.log('GitViz validation passed')"
